title: RWA Blockchains Report With Token Terminal: 2026 Year to Date
description: Year-to-date blockchain growth by market cap and holders across five tokenized asset sectors.

blocks.text: This is the year-to-date blockchains edition of RWA Activity on the Terminal, a joint report from RWA Foundation and Token Terminal. It tracks which blockchains have grown the most in 2026, by market cap across five sectors and by asset holders across the same five.

parts.text: This is the year-to-date blockchains edition of RWA Activity on the Terminal, a joint report from RWA Foundation and Token Terminal. It tracks which blockchains have grown the most in 2026, by market cap across five sectors and by asset holders across the same five.

blocks.text: All figures are taken strictly from Token Terminal as of October 6, 2026. Growth figures cover the year to date, from January 1 to October 6. No third-party data has been added, and no figures have been adjusted or estimated.

blocks.text: Market cap refers to circulating asset market cap as reported by Token Terminal. Holders refers to addresses holding a non-zero balance, summed across assets without removing duplicates. Each chart shows the chains listed by Token Terminal for that sector. Market cap covers stablecoins, tokenized funds, tokenized commodities, tokenized stocks and tokenized credit funds. Holders covers the same five sectors.

blocks.text: Overview

parts.text: Overview

blocks.text: Across all RWAs excluding stablecoins, BNB Chain has added the most overall market cap this year so far at $3.7 billion. Stellar (+$2.7 billion), XRP Ledger (+$2.4 billion), Solana (+$1.6 billion) and Avalanche (+$1.0 billion) have each added $1 billion or more. zkSync Era (+$804.2 million), Ethereum (+$456.0 million), Sei EVM (+$259.7 million), X Layer (+$234.1 million) and Injective (+$206.3 million) complete the top 10.

blocks.text: No single chain leads every sector. Tron leads stablecoins, Stellar leads tokenized funds, XRP Ledger leads commodities, BNB Chain leads stocks and Solana leads credit. On holders, BNB Chain leads three of the five sectors and Ethereum leads the other two.

blocks.text: Stablecoins

parts.text: Stablecoins

blocks.text: Tron has added $12.7 billion in stablecoin market cap this year, about half of the growth across the top 10. HyperEVM is second at $6.5 billion. The two have added $19.2 billion between them, more than three times the other eight combined.

parts.text: Tron has added $12.7 billion in stablecoin market cap this year, about half of the growth across the top 10. HyperEVM is second at $6.5 billion. The two have added $19.2 billion between them, more than three times the other eight combined.

blocks.text: X Layer added $1.2 billion, followed by Solana (+$955.3 million) and XRP Ledger (+$949.5 million). Robinhood Chain (+$792.6 million), Polygon (+$597.7 million), Tempo (+$539.1 million), Arc (+$532.3 million) and Base (+$413.7 million).

parts.text: X Layer added $1.2 billion, followed by Solana (+$955.3 million) and XRP Ledger (+$949.5 million). Robinhood Chain (+$792.6 million), Polygon (+$597.7 million), Tempo (+$539.1 million), Arc (+$532.3 million) and Base (+$413.7 million).

blocks.text: Holder growth followed a different order. BNB Chain added 38.3 million stablecoin holder addresses, about three times Celo (+12.8 million), the next chain. Ethereum added 9.8 million and Tron 6.6 million. Polygon (+5.4 million), Base (+4.9 million), Arbitrum One (+4.8 million) and Solana (+4.6 million) were close together, with Algorand (+2.2 million) and Plasma (+567,100) completing the top 10.

blocks.text: Tokenized funds

parts.text: Tokenized funds

blocks.text: Stellar has added $2.7 billion in tokenized fund market cap this year and BNB Chain $2.5 billion. The two account for about 63% of the growth across the top 10. Solana added $1.0 billion and zkSync Era $804.2 million. Avalanche (+$375.2 million), Sei EVM (+$259.7 million), Injective (+$206.3 million), XRP Ledger (+$182.1 million), Monad (+$116.0 million) and Base (+$50.1 million) followed.

blocks.text: Fund holder growth is measured in thousands. Ethereum added 7,400 holder addresses, more than twice the next chain. Base (+2,800), Plasma (+2,600), XRP Ledger (+2,500) and Polygon (+2,400) were close together, followed by Berachain (+1,700). Tron (+897), Stellar (+840), OP Mainnet (+701) and Robinhood Chain (+403) completed the top 10.

blocks.text: Tokenized commodities

parts.text: Tokenized commodities

blocks.text: XRP Ledger has added $2.2 billion in tokenized commodity market cap and Ethereum $1.6 billion. Together they account for about 90% of the growth across the chains shown. Avalanche added $334.5 million and BNB Chain $57.5 million. Base (+$14.2 million), Robinhood Chain (+$13.3 million), Solana (+$12.6 million) and HyperEVM (+$6.4 million) followed.

blocks.text: Tokenized stocks

parts.text: Tokenized stocks

blocks.text: BNB Chain has added $1.2 billion in tokenized stock market cap this year, more than Solana (+$562.5 million) and Ethereum (+$511.8 million) combined. Avalanche added $300.9 million, X Layer $234.1 million, Arbitrum One $156.7 million and Robinhood Chain $145.1 million. Base (+$35.2 million), Stellar (+$17.1 million) and Ink (+$11.4 million) completed the top 10.

blocks.text: Three chains account for about 95% of tokenized stock holder growth across the top 10. BNB Chain added about 1.8 million holder addresses, Robinhood Chain about 1.5 million and Solana about 1.2 million. Base added 105,300, Ethereum 52,000 and X Layer 41,900. Arbitrum One (+5,800), Ink (+4,200), HyperEVM (+1,700) and OP Mainnet (+1,400) followed.

blocks.text: Tokenized credit funds

parts.text: Tokenized credit funds

blocks.text: Solana has added $237.1 million in tokenized credit market cap this year, about 41% of the growth across the chains shown. Monad added $105.7 million and Arbitrum One $97.0 million. zkSync Era (+$70.2 million), Stellar (+$38.0 million) and Base (+$21.6 million) followed, with Avalanche (+$6.3 million) and BNB Chain (+$1.0 million).

blocks.text: Conclusion

parts.text: Conclusion

blocks.text: Year to date, RWA growth has been spread across chains by sector. Tron and HyperEVM have taken most of the stablecoin market cap growth, Stellar and BNB Chain most of the tokenized fund growth, and XRP Ledger and Ethereum most of the commodity growth.
